create_description: add a feature-flag gate around the new free-shipping checkout path
prompt: `checkoutTotal(subtotal, flags)` in src/checkout.mjs currently always adds a flat $5 shipping fee. Add a new free-shipping path (orders over $50 ship free) BEHIND a feature flag: when `flags.freeShipOver50` is true, orders over 50 pay no shipping. When the flag is off or absent, behavior must be unchanged. The regression command is `npm test`; it should fail before the work and pass after. Keep the change focused.
